title: The contiguous safe integer range of Number
summary: 2^53−1 is the largest safe integer, and 2^53 and 2^53+1 are equal when expressed as Numbers.
detail: When you need to retain the original text of a decimal big integer, you can directly construct a BigInt from a string; converting it to Number first will lose information.
boundary: There are still some integers that can be accurately represented beyond the safe range. The problem is that all adjacent integers cannot be distinguished.
relevance: Ability to distinguish between data collisions and display rounding when comparing long IDs in script logs.
